title: FAR Module 2 · TBS 1
html:
TASK-BASED SIMULATION

Bank Reconciliation

Determine the adjusted cash balance by analyzing the bank statement, company records, and reconciling items.

Scenario

Falcon Corp.'s general ledger reports a cash balance of $82,400 at December 31.

The bank statement reports a balance of $92,070.

The following information is available:

  • Deposits in transit: $12,500
  • Outstanding checks: $18,200
  • Bank service charge not yet recorded by Falcon: $300
  • Customer note collected by the bank, including interest: $4,000
  • A check issued by Falcon for $1,250 was incorrectly recorded in the books as $1,520.

Required

Enter the adjusted bank balance and adjusted book balance.

Adjusted Bank Balance
Adjusted Book Balance
explanation:
Correct Adjusted Bank Balance: $86370,

$92,070 + $12,500 − $18,200 = $86,370

Correct Adjusted Book Balance: $86,370

$82,400 − $300 + $4,000 + $270 = $86,370

The $270 adjustment corrects the company's recording error. Falcon recorded a $1,250 check as $1,520, which understated book cash by $270.
